cues.zh: 既然我们大体上都认同现在该多装热泵了，我想用这期给热泵系列收个尾，聊聊市面上各种各样的热泵类型、这些机器由哪些部件组成、都装在哪里，以及要让一栋建筑从没装热泵到装上热泵，都需要经历些什么。

cues.zh: 新技术总会留下很多误解空间，

cues.en: and this one is particularly fun because heat pumps are not new tech at all.
cues.zh: 而这事儿特别有意思，因为热泵根本就不是什么新技术。

cues.zh: 它们是对早已成熟的技术的改良，只是用法稍有不同。

cues.zh: 点这个就能跳过去。不过简单来说是这样的：热泵是搬运热量，而不是制造热量。虽然室外可能比室内冷，

cues.en: unless we're at absolute zero there is heat energy to be collected out there. And except in really cold ambient conditions,
cues.zh: 但除非到了绝对零度，外面总有热能可以收集。而且除非是在极冷的环境下，

cues.en: as in below minus 13 Celsius or five Fahrenheit, modern heat pumps are able to move at least two and a half times as much energy as they consume in the process,
cues.zh: 也就是低于零下13摄氏度或5华氏度，现代热泵搬运的能量至少是它运行中所消耗能量的2.5倍，

cues.en: making them the most efficient way to use any source of energy for the purpose of heating a building in the vast majority of cases.
cues.zh: 所以在绝大多数情况下，用任何能源给建筑供暖，热泵都是最高效的方式。

cues.en: That means they lessen the need for fossil fuels in the short term which is good for many reasons,
cues.zh: 这意味着它们在短期内减少了对化石燃料的需求，这在很多方面都是好事，

cues.en: and in the long term they make electrification
cues.zh: 从长远来看，它们让电气化

cues.en: and decarbonization
cues.zh: 和去碳化

cues.en: easier because,
cues.zh: 变得更加容易，因为，

cues.en: well, we can do more with less. Pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 好吧，我们可以用更少的资源做更多的事。非常直观。

cues.zh: 在我们继续之前先简单说明一下，

cues.en: I'm focusing today on residential and light commercial stuff. When you get into really big commercial systems,
cues.zh: 我今天主要讲住宅和轻型商业应用。当你接触到真正的大型商业系统时，

cues.en: well,

cues.en: My goal with this video is to give you a basic overview of common system designs,
cues.zh: 我做这期视频的目的是给你一个常见系统设计的宏观概述，

cues.en: talk about some pros and cons of each particularly when it comes to retrofitting existing buildings,
cues.zh: 探讨各自的优缺点，特别是针对现有建筑的改造，

cues.en: and then I'll talk about whatever other stuff comes up as we go along. Strap in.
cues.zh: 然后我会顺便聊聊其他遇到的事情。系好安全带。

cues.en: The first thing we need to talk about actually has nothing to do with heat pumps whatsoever.
cues.zh: 我们首先要讨论的事情其实和热泵完全没有关系。

cues.en: And fair warning, this section might get some folks a little
cues.zh: 先给个友情提醒，这一部分可能会让某些人有点

cues.en: heated.
cues.zh: 上火。

cues.en: The wisest thing we can do in the short term can be expressed in these three simple words
cues.zh: 我们在短期内能做的最明智的事情可以用这三个简单的词来概括：

cues.en: insulate,
cues.zh: 保温，

cues.en: insulate,
cues.zh: 保温，

cues.en: and insulate.
cues.zh: 还是保温。

cues.en: No matter what technology is used to heat a building, the faster heat makes it out of the building through walls and windows, the more heat you need to produce to keep the building warm.
cues.zh: 无论用什么技术来给建筑供暖，热量通过墙壁和窗户逃逸的速度越快，为了保持室内温暖，你需要产生的热量就越多。

cues.en: If you live in a home that was built in the last twenty or thirty years,
cues.zh: 如果你住的是最近二三十年建造的房子，

cues.en: odds are you're probably in a decent place already, depending on where you are of course.
cues.zh: 那大概率你的情况还算不错，当然这取决于你住在哪里。

cues.en: But in older buildings?
cues.zh: 但在老建筑里呢？

cues.en: Well, heat loss is often a major problem.
cues.zh: 嗯，热量流失通常是个大问题。

cues.en: Adding insulation to existing buildings which also by the way includes things like new windows and general weatherizing is a complicated and often spicy topic. Some of this is because buildings are different and techniques suitable for one type of construction
cues.zh: 给现有建筑添加绝缘层——顺便说一下，这也包括换新窗户和整体做防风处理等工作——是一个复杂且往往很棘手的话题。部分原因在于建筑各不相同，适用于某种结构的技术

cues.en: aren't necessarily suitable for others.
cues.zh: 未必适用于其他结构。

cues.en: And sometimes
cues.zh: 而且有时

cues.en: it makes more sense to demolish energy intensive buildings and simply start over.
cues.zh: 把高能耗的建筑拆掉并直接推倒重来，反而更有意义。

cues.en: But that course of action has lots of baggage attached to it so for now let's just
cues.zh: 但这种做法会带来很多麻烦，所以目前我们先

cues.en: ignore it and talk about improving existing buildings.
cues.zh: 忽略这一点，来谈谈如何改造现有建筑。

cues.en: In general,
cues.zh: 总的来说，

cues.en: it's not easy but it's definitely worth doing.
cues.zh: 这虽然不易，但绝对值得去做。

cues.en: Indisputably.
cues.zh: 毋庸置疑。

cues.en: A problem, though, it generally takes a long time to see a return on insulation investments.
cues.zh: 不过有个问题，绝缘投资通常需要很长时间才能看到回报。

cues.en: And when you're an individual simply being asked nicely to do it,
cues.zh: 而当你只是一个被好言相劝去做的个人时，

cues.en: well, that puts you off. After all, if you won't see savings for five or ten years and you aren't even sure you'll stay living where you do by that time,
cues.zh: 嗯，这就让你打退堂鼓了。毕竟，如果你五到十年内都见不到省下的钱，甚至不确定到那时自己还会不会住在现在的地方，

cues.en: it's a hard sell.
cues.zh: 这就很难说服人了。

cues.en: Worse, if you're a landlord who is putting the cost of energy onto your tenants, you just don't care!
cues.zh: 更糟糕的是，如果你是个把能源成本转嫁给租客的房东，你根本就不在乎！

cues.en: Which I, for the record, think is real bad. Shout out to countries that do energy audits on rental units and publish efficiency scores so that potential tenants can see what they're getting into before signing a lease, and so that the landlords have a reason to actually
cues.zh: 顺便声明一下，我觉得这真的很糟糕。向那些会对出租房进行能源审计并公布能效评分的国家致敬，这样潜在租客在签约前就能清楚自己要租的是什么房，同时也让房东有动力去真正

cues.en: do better. I like that a lot.
cues.zh: 做到更好。我非常喜欢这样。

cues.en: Anyway, incentives to insulate, or as I like to call them, insulentives,
cues.zh: 总之，鼓励保温的激励措施——或者我喜欢叫它们“保温激励”（insulentives），

cues.en: are probably something we should be doing. Like, a lot more and faster.
cues.zh: 大概是我们该做的事。而且要多做、快做。

cues.en: In fact,
cues.zh: 事实上，

cues.en: I'll go beyond just insulentives.
cues.zh: 我要说的不止是“保温激励”。

cues.en: We should
cues.zh: 我们应该

cues.en: dare I say it just
cues.zh: 恕我直言，干脆

cues.en: start paying folks to insulate older buildings. Maybe create some sort of energy de intensification agency?
cues.zh: 开始花钱请人给老建筑做保温。也许成立某种降低能源强度的机构？

cues.en: I know. What is this? Energy policy connections?
cues.zh: 我知道。这算什么？能源政策关联？

cues.en: Well, right now it is. The only way to equitably solve this problem is with public policy. And while I'm not here to tell you what exactly that should look like I'm certain something needs to happen.
cues.zh: 嗯，眼下还真是。要公平解决这个问题，唯一办法就是公共政策。我不是来告诉你们它具体该是什么样，但我确定必须得做点什么。

cues.en: And if I were in charge,
cues.zh: 如果我说了算，

cues.en: I would make sure this isn't some financialized scheme
cues.zh: 我会确保这不会变成某种金融化方案，

cues.en: where people get, like, loans tacked onto property tax bills,
cues.zh: 比如让人们背上附加在房产税账单上的贷款，

cues.en: but you can have fun arguing about that down below.
cues.zh: 不过你们可以在下面尽情争论这个。

cues.en: The key problem is that right now many of the buildings which are most in need of insulation upgrades house families who would greatly benefit from them but who cannot afford the investment, or may simply have no say in it at all.
cues.zh: 关键问题是，现在许多最需要保温改造的楼里，住着本来能从中大受益、却负担不起这笔投资，或者根本说不上话的家庭。

cues.en: We should fix this.
cues.zh: 我们应该解决这个问题。

cues.en: The fact is, unless something's gone horribly wrong, every insulation upgrade will pay for itself in time. And I'm just talking about the money part. Include externalities like energy supply stability and reduced carbon emissions and you're getting even more bang for that buck.
cues.zh: 事实是，除非出了大问题，每一项保温改造迟早都会回本。我这还只说钱的部分。把能源供应稳定、碳排放减少这些外部性算进去，这笔钱就更值了。

cues.en: Plus,
cues.zh: 而且，

cues.en: if you can save someone 50 or $100 a month on their energy bills, you've greatly enhanced their financial security which is also good for society.
cues.zh: 如果你能让人每月能源账单省下 50 或 100 美元，就大大增强了他们的财务安全感，这对社会也有好处。

cues.en: The trouble has always been it's a big upfront cost which many simply cannot afford.
cues.zh: 问题一直在于前期成本太高，很多人根本负担不起。

cues.en: Rather than engage in the national pastime of well sucks to be you,
cues.zh: 与其加入“活该你倒霉”这种全民消遣，

cues.en: I would rather we help those folks. Radical, I know.
cues.zh: 我更愿意去帮助那些人。很激进，我知道。

cues.en: And by the way, this problem goes beyond just those who cannot afford it. Sometimes sorely needed upgrades get deferred because incentives to do them just don't line up in any sensible way.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，这个问题不只影响那些负担不起的人。有时候急需的升级被一再推迟，因为做这些事的激励在任何合理的层面上都对不上。

cues.en: For instance, I used to live in an older apartment building where all occupants shared a single gas bill and paid for it collectively in a fixed, budgeted monthly cost.
cues.zh: 比如，我以前住在一栋较旧的公寓楼里，所有住户共用一个燃气账单，按月固定预算分摊。

cues.en: The building was new enough to be pretty well insulated
cues.zh: 那栋楼还算新，隔热做得相当不错，

cues.en: but the windows were awful.
cues.zh: 但窗户很糟糕。

cues.en: They badly needed replacing.
cues.zh: 急需更换。

cues.en: But our energy cost sharing scheme meant that there wasn't a reason for me to bother replacing my four windows.
cues.zh: 但我们的能源费用分摊机制意味着，我没有理由去费心更换我那四扇窗户。

cues.en: My gas use represented maybe 2% of the bill.
cues.zh: 我的燃气用量大概只占账单的2%。

cues.en: So even if I somehow never needed heat again, 98%
cues.zh: 所以即使我 somehow 再也不需要供暖，98%的

cues.en: of my heating costs would remain.
cues.zh: 供暖费用仍然会留在那里。

cues.en: However, if we had gone in together as a building to replace all of the windows we would almost certainly have seen our gas bill drop dramatically
cues.zh: 不过，如果我们作为一栋楼一起行动，更换所有窗户，几乎可以肯定我们的燃气账单会大幅下降，

cues.en: and suddenly the windows would actually pay for themselves, and pretty quickly I'd imagine.
cues.zh: 突然间，窗户就能自己回本了，而且我猜回本会相当快。

cues.en: Getting everyone to agree to it is, of course, the hard part. It's really frustrating when stuff like this incentivizes us to remain in less sustainable scenarios,
cues.zh: 当然，让所有人都同意才是难的部分。当这类事情激励我们停留在不太可持续的场景中时，真的很令人沮丧，

cues.en: and the less fortunate among us often have no choice but to take the worst or even worst option.
cues.zh: 而我们中那些不太幸运的人往往别无选择，只能接受最差甚至更差的选项。

cues.en: Anyway, I'll get off my soapbox. Regardless of how we get there, the better a building can retain heat,
cues.zh: 总之，我不再长篇大论了。不管我们怎么实现，建筑的保温能力越好，

cues.en: the less heating capacity is needed, and this also means the performance challenges heat pumps currently encounter at very cold temperatures
cues.zh: 所需的供暖能力就越小，这也意味着热泵目前在极低温下遇到的性能挑战

cues.en: just become less of an issue. Which of course means well insulated homes are better prepared for a heat pump.
cues.zh: 就不再是大问题。这当然意味着隔热良好的住宅更适合安装热泵。

cues.en: So insulate,
cues.zh: 所以，做好隔热，

cues.en: insulate, insulate.
cues.zh: 隔热，再隔热。

cues.en: Heat pumps are great,
cues.zh: 热泵很棒，

cues.en: but nothing's better than helping a building hold in heat in the winter and keep it out in the summer.
cues.zh: 但没有什么比让建筑在冬天锁住热量、在夏天隔绝热量更好的了。

cues.en: Okay so let's move on, finally.
cues.zh: 好，那我们终于可以继续了。

cues.en: You've got a nicely insulated home and are looking at replacing your whatever with a heat pump. What does that look like? The equipment in a heat pump consists broadly of three parts. The outside unit which absorbs heat from the outside air, the inside unit or units which then put that heat where we want it, and the refrigerant line set or sets that connect them together and actually carry the refrigerant and thus its heat energy from place to place.
cues.zh: 你已经有了一个隔热良好的住宅，正考虑用热泵替换掉原来的设备。这会是什么样呢？热泵的设备大致由三部分组成。室外机从室外空气中吸收热量，室内机则把热量送到我们想要的地方，而制冷剂管路则把它们连接起来，实际输送制冷剂，从而把热能从一个地方带到另一个地方。

cues.en: Sometimes this is all packaged into a single device,
cues.zh: 有时这些全都集成在一个设备里，

cues.en: and we'll look at some of those later on, but more often than not they are split systems.
cues.zh: 我们稍后会看一些这样的产品，但更常见的是分体式系统。

cues.en: Part of why I'm so excited about heat pumps is that they are incredibly flexible and also quite straightforward which a lot of people don't seem to be aware of. I showed you this heat pump in the original videos.
cues.zh: 我对热泵如此兴奋的部分原因是它们极其灵活，而且相当简单，很多人似乎并不知道这一点。我在最初的视频里给你看过这台热泵。

cues.en: This is a single head ductless mini split heat pump and it is the simplest possible split system despite
cues.zh: 这是一台单头无风管迷你分体式热泵，尽管名字这么拗口，

cues.en: that mouthful of a name.
cues.zh: 但它已经是结构最简单的分体系统了。

cues.en: Now, I'm doing a fairly deep dive on this style of system first because,
cues.zh: 现在，我要对这种类型的系统进行比较深入的探讨，

cues.en: well, for one thing I have experience with it but also because in my opinion it has a lot of advantages.
cues.zh: 一方面是因为我有这方面的经验，另一方面在我看来它有很多优势。

cues.en: I don't expect it to become that popular here in The US outside of certain cases since so many homes are already set up for ducted heat distribution.
cues.zh: 除了某些特定情况外，我预计它在美国不会那么受欢迎，因为很多家庭已经配备了风管式供暖系统。

cues.en: As you'll see later, that's a fantastic opportunity for us.
cues.zh: 正如你稍后会看到的，这对我们来说是一个极好的机会。

cues.en: But in places which aren't,
cues.zh: 但在没有这种条件的地方，

cues.en: this option presents a lot of opportunities.
cues.zh: 这种方案带来了很多机遇。

cues.en: This style of system employs simple versions of those three basic heat pump components The outside unit, the inside unit, here it's called the head and is mounted on the wall, and the refrigerant line set. In this case that includes not only the insulated copper tubing which carries the refrigerant, but also a power and communications cable.
cues.zh: 这种类型的系统采用了那三个基础热泵组件的简化版本：室外机、室内机（这里称为“头”，安装在墙上）以及制冷剂管路组件。在本例中，它不仅包含输送制冷剂的绝缘铜管，还包含一根电源和通信电缆。

cues.en: Now, the reason I think this style of heat pump has a lot of potential
cues.zh: 现在，我认为这种热泵极具潜力的原因

cues.en: is that it's frankly ridiculously
cues.zh: 在于它坦白讲实在太

cues.en: easy to deploy.
cues.zh: 容易部署了。

cues.en: And I don't think that's hyperbole.
cues.zh: 而且我觉得这并不是夸大其词。

cues.en: Let me explain why.
cues.zh: 让我来解释一下为什么。

cues.en: All it took to get this unit functional was determining where to mount the components,
cues.zh: 让这台设备运行起来所需要做的，只是确定组件的安装位置，

cues.en: running a new electrical circuit to the outside unit through a disconnect switch
cues.zh: 通过断路器开关为室外机接入一条新的供电线路，

cues.en: drilling a hole in the wall to run the line set and comm wire through,
cues.zh: 在墙上钻一个孔以便穿过管路组件和通信线，

cues.en: actually mounting the indoor and outdoor units,
cues.zh: 实际安装室内机和室外机，

cues.en: and then connecting them together with flare fittings on the refrigerant lines and terminated wiring on the electrical side.
cues.zh: 然后通过制冷剂管路上的喇叭口接头和电气端的端接线将它们连接起来。

cues.en: This was so simple
cues.zh: 这太简单了

cues.en: I did it myself over a day. The most complicated part was evacuating the line set using a vacuum pump and manifold gauges.
cues.zh: 我花了一天时间自己就搞定了。最复杂的部分是用真空泵和歧管压力表来排空管线里的空气。

cues.en: Otherwise,
cues.zh: 除此之外，

cues.en: no special tools were required.
cues.zh: 不需要任何特殊工具。

cues.en: Just a drill and some wrenches, basically.
cues.zh: 基本上只需要一把电钻和几把扳手。

cues.en: Real quick, I'm not suggesting that you follow my example and go all DIY here. In many places it's not even legal to work on refrigeration equipment yourself because if you mess up you can let the refrigerant out and we generally don't want that.
cues.zh: 顺便说一下，我并不是建议大家效仿我去搞什么 DIY。在很多地方，自己动手修制冷设备甚至是不合法的，因为一旦搞砸了会导致制冷剂泄漏，而这通常是我们极力避免的。

cues.en: That's why people get licensed for this. I'm telling you that I did this myself to point out this ain't complicated or particularly difficult.
cues.zh: 这也是为什么人们需要为此考证。我讲我自己的经历，是为了说明这其实并不复杂，也没那么难。

cues.en: One concern many people have, especially in locations where air conditioning is rare, is that there aren't enough technicians qualified to install this equipment.
cues.zh: 很多人都有一个顾虑，特别是在空调不常见的地区，那就是没有足够的合格技术人员来安装这种设备。

cues.en: That is a problem, yes, but I hope you can see through this example
cues.zh: 这确实是个问题，但我希望通过这个例子你能看出，

cues.en: that it's not actually that difficult to get folks up to speed.
cues.zh: 要让大家快速上手其实并没有那么难。

cues.en: I barely know what I'm doing but simply by following the instructions
cues.zh: 我其实对这块儿一知半解，但仅仅是照着说明书操作，

cues.en: I managed to get this up and running, and after three winter seasons it's still working just fine so I think I can say I didn't screw it up. Aside from who installs it and how hard it is, let's look at other options. If you want or need the indoor unit somewhere other than literally on the other side of the wall,
cues.zh: 我就把它安装调试成功了。经历了三个冬天它依然运行良好，所以我想我可以拍胸脯说我没搞砸。抛开由谁来安装以及安装有多难不谈，我们来看看其他的方案。如果你希望或者需要把室内机安装在不只是隔壁墙的别处，

cues.en: that's definitely doable. Generally, you can run up to 30 meters or 100 feet of line between the units, though you may need to adjust the refrigerant charge in that case.
cues.zh: 那完全是可行的。一般来说，机组之间的管线长度最长可以达到 30 米或 100 英尺，不过这种情况下你可能需要调整制冷剂的充注量。

cues.en: Which, again, is what actual professionals are for.
cues.zh: 这正是真正专业人士的用武之地。

cues.en: And what if you need more than one indoor unit, which you probably do?
cues.zh: 那如果你需要不止一台室内机呢？很可能你确实需要。

cues.en: Well, here's where mini split systems get really interesting.
cues.zh: 这就是迷你分体系统真正有意思的地方。

cues.en: The Asian manufacturers
cues.zh: 亚洲的制造商们

cues.en: have for quite a while now been building these sorta like LEGO sets.
cues.zh: 已经有一段时间了，一直在像搭乐高积木一样制造这些东西。

cues.en: They are very modular. Outdoor units are available in many different capacities
cues.zh: 它们非常模块化。室外机有多种不同容量可选

cues.en: and with connections to multiple indoor units. And thanks to clever stuff like electronic expansion valves and on the fly load calculation,
cues.zh: 并且可以连接多台室内机。而且得益于电子膨胀阀和实时负载计算这类巧妙设计，

cues.en: one of these bad boys might have five or more line sets connected to it all going to different heat exchangers in different rooms.
cues.zh: 其中一台这样的猛货可能连接着五组甚至更多的管路，全都通向不同房间的不同热交换器。

cues.en: That not only gives you individual room control which is pretty neat but greatly simplifies the installation process.
cues.zh: 这不仅让你能实现单个房间独立控制——这相当不错——还大大简化了安装过程。

cues.en: You only need electrical power run to one outdoor unit, and it will send power to all the indoor units through cables run with the line sets.
cues.zh: 你只需要给一台室外机供电，它就会通过随管路一起铺设的电缆向所有室内机供电。

cues.en: That's actually something I want to focus on for a beat. I was unaware of this and was expecting that the indoor head would need its own power source. As a matter of fact, I didn't even consider a unit like this because of that false assumption.
cues.zh: 这一点我其实想专门聊一下。我之前并不知道这个，还以为室内机需要自己的电源。事实上，正因为这个错误假设，我压根没考虑过这种机型。

cues.en: It seemed like far too much of a pain.
cues.zh: 看起来实在太麻烦了。

cues.en: But once I knew that the outside unit is in control of everything, shout out to Aging Wheels for his video on how he installed these, I realized this was way more flexible than I assumed, and as a matter of fact it became far and away the easiest option in my specific scenario.
cues.zh: 但一旦我知道室外机掌控一切——感谢 Aging Wheels 他那期关于如何安装这些的视频——我意识到这比我以为的要灵活得多，事实上，它成了我这种具体情况里遥遥领先的最简单选择。

cues.en: Now, when you have a more complicated system with multiple heads in multiple rooms,
cues.zh: 当系统更复杂，多个室内机分布在多个房间时，

cues.en: this does add the difficulty of dealing with the spaghetti that is a bunch of refrigerant lines,
cues.zh: 这确实会增加处理一堆制冷剂管路这种“面条”般混乱局面的难度，

cues.en: But they can be run-in various ways. They can go through attics or wall cavities,
cues.zh: 但它们可以采用多种方式布线。可以穿过阁楼或墙腔，

cues.en: they can be run alongside or up exterior walls in concealing chases,
cues.zh: 也可以沿着外墙或沿外墙向上敷设在隐蔽的线槽里，

cues.en: it's really up to you. And, it should be noted, the indoor units don't have to be these wall mounted things. There are options which get concealed in ceilings,
cues.zh: 这完全取决于你。而且需要注意的是，室内机不一定非得是这种壁挂式的。还有隐藏在天花板里的选择，

cues.en: they can be floor mounted devices akin to radiators,
cues.zh: 也可以是类似暖气片的地面安装设备，

cues.en: and there are more options too like air handlers or surface mounted ceiling thingies which look like something out of a starship.
cues.zh: 还有更多选择，比如风机盘管，或者看起来像是从星舰里搬出来的表面安装式天花板装置。

cues.en: The really cool thing about refrigeration technology
cues.zh: 制冷技术真正酷的地方在于

cues.en: is that it's quite flexible so the sky's the limit.
cues.zh: 它非常灵活，所以天空才是极限。

cues.en: And perhaps the biggest advantage of systems like this is that they are cooling capable out of the box.
cues.zh: 而这类系统最大的优势或许在于，它们开箱即具备制冷能力。

cues.en: One thing you always have to deal with when cooling the air is water.
cues.zh: 给空气降温时，你总得处理一样东西：水。

cues.en: Water vapor in the air condenses on cold surfaces,
cues.zh: 空气中的水蒸气会在低温表面凝结，

cues.en: and so when cooling the air this condensate collects and needs to be dealt with.
cues.zh: 所以给空气降温时，这些冷凝水会积聚起来，需要处理。

cues.en: A standard ductless head like this has a water pan at the bottom and a little drain hose directs the water that collects in it elsewhere.
cues.zh: 像这样的标准无管道室内机底部有一个接水盘，一根小排水管会把积聚在里面的水引到别处。

cues.en: The simplest setup is to mount the head on an exterior wall and drill a small hole for the drain hose, or just run it out with the refrigerant lines if they came in from outside,
cues.zh: 最简单的做法是把室内机安装在外墙上，钻一个小孔让排水管穿出，或者干脆让排水管跟制冷剂管路一起走，如果那些管路是从外面进来的话，

cues.en: thus letting it just sorta pee out as it collects.
cues.zh: 这样水积起来后就能直接排出去。

cues.en: But if that's not an option, there are other solutions, too, like condensate pumps.
cues.zh: 但如果这不是个选项，也还有其他解决方案，比如冷凝泵。

cues.en: But what if you currently heat your home with a boiler that circulates hot water through some pipes and releases heat in radiators?
cues.zh: 但如果你目前是用锅炉来取暖，通过管道循环热水并在散热器中散热呢？

cues.en: Well, there is a heat pump for you, and it can often also produce domestic hot water if you use such a combined system.
cues.zh: 好吧，其实也有适合你的热泵，如果你使用的是这种组合系统，它通常还能产生生活热水。

cues.en: Before I get into it, though, I do just want to say that unless you are firmly committed to the idea of hydronic heating, which in fairness I know many people are,
cues.zh: 不过，在我深入讲解之前，我只想说，除非你坚决倾向于水暖加热（说实话我知道很多人确实如此），

cues.en: I really really think you ought to consider a ductless system.
cues.zh: 我真的非常非常认为你应该考虑一下无风管系统。

cues.en: I know it takes some adjustment getting used to warm air being pushed around,
cues.zh: 我知道习惯热空气到处吹需要一点适应过程，

cues.en: but these heads are very very quiet and it's really not that bad.
cues.zh: 但这些室内机非常非常安静，其实真没那么糟。

cues.en: I recognize that in many cases ductless systems are not a perfect fit. Like for instance in bathrooms.
cues.zh: 我知道在很多情况下，无风管系统并不是最完美的匹配，比如浴室。

cues.en: There's no sense running a line set to a head in such a small space,
cues.zh: 在这么小的空间里铺设管线连接室内机毫无意义，

cues.en: but if it's on an outside wall there's probably already a radiator in there because it needs heat.
cues.zh: 但如果它靠着外墙，里面可能已经有一个散热器了，因为它需要热量。

cues.en: Also, let's face it, these aren't the prettiest things so I get it. I'm just saying don't rule these out right away particularly since they offer cooling which might be increasingly necessary as time goes on.
cues.zh: 另外，说实话，这些东西长得也不是最好看的，所以我理解。我只是说不要马上排除它们，特别是它们还能提供制冷功能，随着时间的推移，这可能会越来越必要。

cues.en: If you're on team radiator, though
cues.zh: 不过，如果你是散热器阵营的，

cues.en: air to water heat pumps are pretty common.
cues.zh: 空气源热水热泵其实很常见。

cues.en: These will effectively replace a boiler by running a refrigerant line set from an outside heat collecting unit much like this one into a refrigerant to water heat exchanger which replaces your boiler.
cues.zh: 这些设备可以有效地替代锅炉：它们从像这样的室外集热单元引出一组冷媒管，连接到冷媒-水热交换器，从而替代你的锅炉。

cues.en: This can be a more turnkey solution,
cues.zh: 这可以是一种更省心的一站式方案，

cues.en: however these units generally don't produce water as hot as a conventional boiler does.
cues.zh: 不过这些机组通常无法把水加热到传统锅炉那么高的温度。

cues.en: Depending on the radiators you currently have,
cues.zh: 这取决于你现有的散热器，

cues.en: this could be an issue.
cues.zh: 这可能就会成为问题。

cues.en: The solution is pretty simple in that case, just replacing radiators as necessary,
cues.zh: 那种情况下解决办法很简单，只需按需更换散热器，

cues.en: but if it comes up, well then that's more work and more cost.
cues.zh: 但如果真遇到这种情况，那就会更费工也更费钱。

cues.en: Also an option are high temperature air to water heat pumps that eliminate that potential hiccup but those tend to be less efficient particularly in cold climates
cues.zh: 另一个选择是高温空气-水热泵，它能消除这个潜在麻烦，但这类设备效率往往较低，尤其是在寒冷气候下，

cues.en: so there is definitely a trade off.
cues.zh: 所以肯定要有所取舍。

cues.en: As is the case with pretty much everything.
cues.zh: 几乎任何事情都是这样。

cues.en: But anyway, one thing that I want to stress is that all a heat pump does is collect heat from outside and move it, one might say pump it, indoors.
cues.zh: 但不管怎样，我想强调一点：热泵所做的全部事情，就是从室外收集热量并把它搬到室内，也可以说是“泵”进室内。

cues.en: The equipment which accomplishes this might seem a little strange if you're not used to it, and it definitely feels weird to be getting heat from colder air.
cues.zh: 实现这一点的设备，如果你不熟悉，可能会觉得有点奇怪；而从更冷的空气中获取热量，确实感觉怪怪的。

cues.en: But the end goal is the same as it always has been, release heat where we want it so our homes stay warm.
cues.zh: 但最终目标始终没变：把热量释放到我们想要的地方，让家里保持温暖。

cues.en: Air to water heat pumps allow you to use pretty much the same heat distribution system you already have which has value, especially since there's typically only one line set to run-in that case so the installation is less intensive.
cues.zh: 空气-水热泵让你基本可以沿用现有的热量分配系统，这很有价值，尤其是这种情况下通常只需铺设一套管路，所以安装强度更低。

cues.en: Plus, of course, there is value in familiarity, too.
cues.zh: 当然，熟悉感本身也有价值。

cues.en: I would suggest, however, that you make a deep assessment before committing to one or the other, assuming you have the choice.
cues.zh: 不过，如果你有得选，我建议在选定其中一种之前先做深入评估。

cues.en: Now I'd like to focus on the challenges to heat pump adoption, with a particular emphasis on the situation here in The United States.
cues.zh: 现在我想重点谈谈热泵普及面临的挑战，尤其聚焦美国这里的情况。

cues.en: As I said in an earlier video,
cues.zh: 正如我在早前视频里说的，

cues.en: the
cues.zh: 这个

cues.en: immensely frustrating thing about the way heat pumps have been deployed here is that the vast majority of single family homes already have excellent infrastructure in place for a heat pump.
cues.zh: 在这里部署热泵的方式让人极其沮丧的一点是，绝大多数独栋住宅其实已经具备安装热泵的优良基础设施。

cues.en: Many other housing types are well prepared, too, but homes with central air conditioning are basically already set.
cues.zh: 许多其他住房类型也准备得很充分，但装有中央空调的房子基本已经万事俱备。

cues.en: There is already an outside unit with a decent electrical supply run to it. There is already an inside unit in the form of an evaporator coil. Someone has already planned a path for a line set to go and even went so far as to put it there.
cues.zh: 外面已经有室外机，并且接有足够好的供电；室内也已经有蒸发器盘管这种室内机。甚至有人已经规划好冷媒管的走向，甚至直接把管路都铺好了。

cues.en: And there is already an air handler and ductwork
cues.zh: 而且已经有空气处理机和风管系统

cues.en: to work with it all.
cues.zh: 可以和这一整套配合使用。

cues.en: And of course that means a lot of boxes,
cues.zh: 当然，这意味着很多条件

cues.en: in fact pretty much all of them, are already checked for many people over here.
cues.zh: 事实上对这里的很多人来说，几乎所有条件都已经打勾满足了。

cues.en: Because,
cues.zh: 因为，

cues.en: once again,
cues.zh: 再说一次，

cues.en: air conditioners
cues.zh: 空调

cues.en: are heat pumps.
cues.zh: 就是热泵。

cues.en: We just tend to not bother with the reversing valves because but sometimes
cues.zh: 我们只是通常懒得装四通阀，因为……但有时候

cues.en: thinking is rampant.
cues.zh: 这种想法很普遍。

cues.en: The good news of widespread use of air conditioning is that we already have trained technicians who know how to install and service heat pumps.
cues.zh: 空调广泛使用的好消息是，我们已经有受过培训的技术人员，知道如何安装和维护热泵。

cues.en: They're doing it all the time even if we haven't realized it. And that is an advantage compared to other parts of the world.
cues.zh: 他们一直在做这件事，哪怕我们没意识到。与世界其他地区相比，这是一个优势。

cues.en: The less good news for us is that, so far anyway,
cues.zh: 不过对我们来说坏消息是，至少目前来看，

cues.en: systems which could best take advantage of all that existing infrastructure
cues.zh: 那些最能充分利用现有基础设施的系统，

cues.en: just aren't very good.
cues.zh: 表现并不怎么样。

cues.en: I'm not just saying that, by way. I can back this up with data.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，我可不是随口说说，我是有数据支持的。

cues.en: A fantastic resource I was pointed to by Ian on Twitter is the list of air source heat pumps maintained by NEEP, the Northeast Energy Efficiency Partnerships.
cues.zh: Twitter 上的 Ian 给我推荐过一个绝佳的资源，是由东北能效合作伙伴（NEEP）维护的空气源热泵清单。

cues.en: They track, among other things, the COP at five degrees, and we can simply sort by that figure and see who's making the best stuff.
cues.zh: 它追踪了包括 5 度时的 COP 等多项指标，我们只需按该数值排序，就能看看到底谁的产品最强。

cues.en: Right now I want you to look at the ducting configuration
cues.zh: 现在我想让大家看一下“风道配置”

cues.en: column.
cues.zh: 这一列。

cues.en: The best performers are overwhelmingly
cues.zh: 表现最出色的绝大部分都是

cues.en: non ducted configurations.
cues.zh: 无风道配置。

cues.en: These are mini split systems.
cues.zh: 这些都是 mini split（小分体）系统。

cues.en: When you see multi zone mix of non ducted and ducted,
cues.zh: 当你看到“多分区无风道与有风道混用”时，

cues.en: those are the LEGO like systems I was talking about earlier. Those can connect to both a ductless head and a ducted air handler at the same time, which is pretty neat. Hello.
cues.zh: 就是我前面提到的那种乐高式系统。它们能同时连接无风道室内机和有风道的空气处理器，非常酷。嗨，等等。

cues.en: Voice over me is here to tell you that, well,
cues.zh: 画外音的我此时上线告诉你：呃，

cues.en: this section of the video has become a bit of a disaster.
cues.zh: 视频的这部分可以说是有点翻车了。

cues.en: I'll explain, but first these excellent systems at the very top of the list aren't just mini splits. Some are what are known as VRF
cues.zh: 听我解释，不过首先，排在最前面的这些优秀系统可不只是 mini split。有些是所谓的 VRF

cues.en: systems, and that stands for variable refrigerant flow.
cues.zh: 系统，也就是变制冷剂流量系统。

cues.en: This tech is really neat because when some rooms are too warm but others are too cold,
cues.zh: 这项技术非常巧妙，因为当有些房间过热、有些房间太冷时，

cues.en: it allows the system to move heat within the building.
cues.zh: 它可以直接在建筑物内部转移热量。

cues.en: It does this by pumping the refrigerant between rooms, taking energy out of one room to cool it, and dumping it in another to warm it up.
cues.zh: 它的原理是在各个房间之间循环输送制冷剂，从一个房间吸走热量给它降温，再排到另一个房间给它升温。

cues.en: That tech is pretty unlikely to see use in the home, although apartment buildings are likely to deploy it. This excellent Fujitsu machine for example can actually have 15 heads connected to it and since any head can heat while the others are cooling or
cues.zh: 这种技术不太可能用在普通独栋住宅，但公寓楼很可能会采用。比如这款优秀的 Fujitsu 设备实际上可以连接 15 台室内机，由于任意一台在制热的同时其他机器可以制冷，或者

cues.en: it's ideal for multi family setups.
cues.zh: 它非常适合多户住宅。

cues.en: Best of all, its performance is amazing.
cues.zh: 最棒的是，它的性能极其惊艳。

cues.en: Its COP is a stellar 3.54
cues.zh: 它的 COP（能效比）高达出色的 3.54，

cues.en: even at five Fahrenheit or minus 13 Celsius.
cues.zh: 哪怕是在华氏 5 度，也就是零下 13 摄氏度的低温下也是如此。

cues.en: And it retains nearly all of its capacity at that temperature.
cues.zh: 而且在那个温度下，它几乎能保持全部制热能力。

cues.en: The performance of this machine is so good that even here in Chicago,
cues.zh: 这台设备的性能好到即便是在芝加哥这种地方，

cues.en: so long as you had decent insulation, there would almost never be a need for an alternate heat source, which is fantastic.
cues.zh: 只要房屋保温做得尚可，就几乎完全不需要备用热源，这简直太棒了。

cues.en: Anyway, I was about to say, to see the machines that American homes can best take advantage of, we need to filter for single zone centrally ducted systems, and then I would have shown you how there's basically only one decent product line from Carrier
cues.zh: 总之我刚才想说的是，要看哪些设备最适合美国家庭，我们需要筛选单分区中央风管系统，然后我本想展示给大家看，基本上只有 Carrier 的一条产品线还算拿得出手，

cues.en: and nothing else.
cues.zh: 其他就再无可选了。

cues.en: This is still kinda close to the case, and the American giants of the industry should absolutely be ashamed of themselves for continuing to pump out the same mediocre equipment.
cues.zh: 现在的情况基本还是这样，美国本土的行业巨头们真该为继续大量生产这种平庸的设备感到羞愧。

cues.en: Ancient 13 SEER air conditioners, which is a horrible efficiency in 2022,
cues.zh: 老旧的 13 SEER 空调——在 2022 年这种能效简直低得可怕——

cues.en: are still getting made unfortunately.
cues.zh: 不幸的是竟然还在继续生产。

cues.en: While various companies in Asia are actually innovating.
cues.zh: 而亚洲的多家公司实际上正在创新。

cues.en: However, I can happily report that the situation is at least a bit better than that.
cues.zh: 不过，我可以高兴地报告，情况至少比那要好一点。

cues.en: For whatever reason, when I first wrote this section, I couldn't see any of these units.
cues.zh: 不知为何，我第一次写这一部分时，看不到这些单元中的任何一个。

cues.en: Those with the brands Allied, Duquesne, Comfort Air, Concorde, and Century.
cues.zh: 那些拥有Allied、Duquesne、Comfort Air、Concorde和Century品牌的。

cues.en: Maybe these just got added to the list. Maybe Maybe something was wonky when I looked it up. I don't know. But these have a very good COP at five Fahrenheit
cues.zh: 也许这些只是被加到了列表里。也许我查的时候出了点问题。我不知道。但这些在5华氏度时的COP非常好

cues.en: and retain a decent chunk of their capacity in that cold.
cues.zh: 并且在那种寒冷中保留了相当大一部分能力。

cues.en: It could be better. Yes. But roughly two thirds is still pretty good.
cues.zh: 它可以更好。是的。但大约三分之二仍然相当不错。

cues.en: That'll keep your backup system from kicking on unless it gets frightfully cold. And these are your typical,
cues.zh: 这会让你的备用系统不会启动，除非天气变得非常寒冷。而这些是你典型的、

cues.en: what I call, barrel style American outdoor units and evaporator coils. This is the exact sort of equipment that gets installed here all the time.
cues.zh: 我称之为桶式美国户外机组和蒸发器盘管。这正是这里一直安装的那种设备。

cues.en: The fact is there's really nothing fundamentally different between one of these and a mini split. They're the same parts. In fact, the same machines
cues.zh: 事实是，这些和迷你分体式之间真的没有根本区别。它们是相同的部件。事实上，相同的机器

cues.en: just in different form factors.
cues.zh: 只是外形不同。

cues.en: It seems that the tech which gets put into commodity mini splits as a matter of course, basically variable speed compressors and more intelligent control logic,
cues.zh: 似乎那些作为常规被放入商品化迷你分体式中的技术，基本上是变速压缩机和更智能的控制逻辑，

cues.en: is finally making its way into at least a few American style machines.
cues.zh: 终于至少进入了少数美国风格的机器中。

cues.en: Now, the other thing I want to talk about here is the HSPF
cues.zh: 现在，我在这里想谈的另一件事是HSPF

cues.en: or heating seasonal performance factor.
cues.zh: 或供暖季节性能系数。

cues.en: This is a metric which attempts to give an overall average efficiency throughout a heating season.
cues.zh: 这个指标试图给出整个采暖季的整体平均效率。

cues.en: These units all have pretty mediocre HSPF
cues.zh: 这些机组的 HSPF

cues.en: ratings,
cues.zh: 评级都相当平庸，

cues.en: which is very weird because an HSPF of nine
cues.zh: 这很奇怪，因为 HSPF 为 9

cues.en: should indicate an average COP of only 2.63.
cues.zh: 按理说对应的平均 COP 只有 2.63。

cues.en: But here on the NEEP list it bests that even at five degrees Fahrenheit.
cues.zh: 但在 NEEP 名单上，它甚至在华氏 5 度时都优于这个水平。

cues.en: I do not know the reason for this discrepancy and if you do, by all means, please share.
cues.zh: 我不知道这种差异的原因；如果你知道，请务必分享。

cues.en: Now, although the situation is improving for us, it's still pretty bad, and there are some other complications which I'll get to in a bit. But now, to set the stage for the section, pretend that you didn't know about the units we just saw and that there was only one decent product line available in The US. You'd probably wanna ask,
cues.zh: 现在，虽然我们这边的情况在改善，但仍然相当糟糕，还有一些其他复杂情况我稍后会讲。不过现在，为了给本节做铺垫，假设你不知道我们刚看到的这些机组，而且美国市场上只有一条还算不错的产品线。你大概会问，

cues.en: why is this?
cues.zh: 为什么会这样？

cues.en: Well, I'd be happy to speculate.
cues.zh: 嗯，我很乐意猜一猜。

cues.en: I think a number of factors have combined to make the American manufacturers
cues.zh: 我认为多种因素共同作用，让美国制造商

cues.en: largely
cues.zh: 很大程度上

cues.en: just not really care.
cues.zh: 就是不太在乎。

cues.en: First, the historically cheap cost of natural gas means that there's been little reason from the consumer's point of view to go with a heat pump if they have access to the gas grid.
cues.zh: 首先，天然气历来便宜，这意味着从消费者角度看，如果能接入燃气管网，就没什么理由选择热泵。

cues.en: And, since most really cold places have gas grids, at least where there's the density to make it work, it's rational from a consumer's perspective
cues.zh: 而且，大多数真正寒冷的地方都有燃气管网，至少在人口密度足以支撑的地方是这样；从消费者角度看，这是理性的

cues.en: to not bother with a heat pump.
cues.zh: 不去折腾热泵。

cues.en: Because energy is energy, you can convert the units your natural gases build in, here that's the therm, to the kilowatt hour and make an apples to apples cost comparison.
cues.zh: 因为能量就是能量，你可以把天然气账单使用的单位——这里是 therm——换算成千瓦时，做同口径的成本比较。

cues.en: Here in Chicagoland,
cues.zh: 在芝加哥地区，

cues.en: at least until recently, gas has cost about a quarter what electricity does for the same amount of delivered energy.
cues.zh: 至少直到最近，相同能量的天然气成本大约只有电力的四分之一。

cues.en: That has meant that heat pumps basically never made any sense here. Locally, we need a consistent COP of four just to break even with the cost of gas,
cues.zh: 这意味着热泵在这里根本没有任何意义。在当地，我们需要保持 4 的 COP 才能勉强抵消天然气的成本，

cues.en: and attaining that is,
cues.zh: 而要达到这一点，

cues.en: frankly,
cues.zh: 坦白说，

cues.en: hard.
cues.zh: 很难。

cues.en: Even now, but especially twenty plus years ago.
cues.zh: 即使现在如此，二十多年前更是如此。

cues.en: Around here, people just wanted air conditioning in the summer and already had some sort of cheap heat which a heat pump couldn't touch on cost.
cues.zh: 在这里，人们夏天只想装空调，而且已经有了某种廉价的供暖方式，这是热泵在成本上无法比拟的。

cues.en: And so the typical air conditioning system in my climate is
cues.zh: 所以在我的气候区，典型的空调系统

cues.en: super basic.
cues.zh: 超级基础。

cues.en: In most cases it's a single capacity,
cues.zh: 在大多数情况下，它是一个单一容量、

cues.en: single speed system that is either on or off. And of course it's tacked on to the gas fired heating system made by the same manufacturer.
cues.zh: 单转速的系统，要么开，要么关。当然，它是附加在同一家制造商生产的燃气供暖系统上的。

cues.en: Makes you wonder if they don't want to cannibalize their furnace sales, doesn't it? Now, most all of these manufacturers do make reversible air conditioners and have for many years.
cues.zh: 这不禁让人怀疑他们是不想蚕食自家炉具的销量，对吧？现在，几乎所有这些制造商都在制造可逆式空调，并且已经很多年了。

cues.en: But in general, they're the same basic one speed, one capacity condensing units that we install here but equipped with a reversing valve and some sort of defrost timers.
cues.zh: 但总体而言，它们与我们这里安装的基本单速、单一容量冷凝单元相同，只是配备了换向阀和某种除霜定时器。

cues.en: As a matter of fact, if you've ever wondered why a thermostat terminal board has so many connections,
cues.zh: 事实上，如果你曾纳闷为什么恒温器的端子板上有那么多连接线，

cues.en: well the o terminal tells the condenser to reverse flow for heating.
cues.zh: 那么 O 端子就是告诉冷凝器反转流动来进行制热。

cues.en: Now, those heat pumps, although they're mediocre,
cues.zh: 现在，这些热泵虽然表现平平，

cues.en: work well enough in the regions of The US with milder climates,
cues.zh: 但在美国气候较温和的地区，它们的效果足够好，

cues.en: and those regions typically don't have widespread gas infrastructure
cues.zh: 而这些地区通常没有普及的天然气基础设施，

cues.en: so many homes are all electric from the start.
cues.zh: 所以很多住宅从一开始就全都是用电的。

cues.en: These factors have combined to create little reason for American HVAC manufacturers
cues.zh: 这些因素综合起来，导致美国的暖通制造商几乎没有动力

cues.en: to develop their air conditioners into competent cold climate heat pumps.
cues.zh: 把自家的空调升级成胜任极寒气候的热泵。

cues.en: And the lasting effect of all this is that we are currently in a place where getting a cold climate heat pump is just not
cues.zh: 这一切带来的深远影响，就是我们现在想买到耐寒热泵

cues.en: easy here even though we are pumping out heat pumps right and left.
cues.zh: 极其困难，尽管市面上的普通热泵多如牛毛。

cues.en: We make loads of air conditioners but relatively few are made reversible
cues.zh: 我们生产了海量的空调，但相对很少做成冷暖双向的，

cues.en: and fewer still are equipped with the tech to make them heat when it gets Chicago levels of cold.
cues.zh: 而具备在芝加哥那种严寒下正常制热技术的，就更是凤毛麟角。

cues.en: This limited supply, combined with the sudden interest in heat pumps, has led to many suppliers and installers charging
cues.zh: 有限的供应加上人们对热泵骤增的兴趣，导致许多供应商和安装商

cues.en: rather absurd premiums for these systems, if you can even get them to give you a quote.
cues.zh: 对这些系统开出极其离谱的溢价——前提是你还能要到报价的话。

cues.en: Let me tell you a story.
cues.zh: 我来给大家讲个故事。

cues.en: A friend of mine had their AC unit die last summer. Their heat source is propane which,
cues.zh: 去年夏天，我朋友家的空调彻底报废了。他们原本是用丙烷取暖的，

cues.en: while cheaper than electricity,
cues.zh: 虽然比用电便宜，

cues.en: isn't that much cheaper.
cues.zh: 但也便宜不了多少。

cues.en: I suggested that they should look into getting a Mitsubishi Hyperheat unit, and I helped arrange quotes from the local HVAC company who is one of Mitsubishi's authorized contractors.
cues.zh: 我建议他们考虑装一台 Mitsubishi Hyperheat，并帮他们联系了当地一家作为 Mitsubishi 授权承包商的暖通公司来报价。

cues.en: A basic replacement of the air conditioner, including a new evaporator coil and line set, was quoted at $3,000
cues.zh: 最基础的空调更换方案，包括更换新的蒸发器盘管和连接管线，报价是 3000 美元。

cues.en: This option would continue to use the existing furnace as the air handler and thus propane for heat.
cues.zh: 这个方案会继续沿用现有的暖风炉作为空气处理机，也就是依然靠丙烷取暖。

cues.en: A three head ductless system from Mitsubishi,
cues.zh: 而 Mitsubishi 的一拖三无管道系统，

cues.en: a perfect solution for their small home in a number of ways,
cues.zh: 在各方面都是他们这种小户型的完美方案，

cues.en: would cost
cues.zh: 报价却高达

cues.en: more than $12,000.
cues.zh: 12000 美元以上。

cues.en: That's a gigantic
cues.zh: 这可是一个巨大的

cues.en: price difference.
cues.zh: 价格差。

cues.en: And if we dig a little into it, we find what can only be described as greed.
cues.zh: 如果我们深入挖掘一下，就会发现这只能用贪婪来形容。

cues.en: Yes, the equipment from Mitsubishi is expensive compared to the commodity grade carrier equipment in the other quote.
cues.zh: 是的，与另一份报价中的普通级运营商设备相比，三菱的设备确实很贵。

cues.en: But it's not $9,000
cues.zh: 但它并没有贵出

cues.en: more expensive.
This online wholesaler would sell me similar equipment for about $5,500
cues.zh: 这家在线批发商卖给我的同类设备大约只要 5,500 美元

cues.en: shipped.
cues.zh: 包邮。

cues.en: Let's say that with the line sets and a few other ancillary things, the equipment cost is $6,500.
cues.zh: 假设加上管线组件和其他一些辅助配件，设备成本是 6,500 美元。

cues.en: Now I know that mounting wall units and drilling holes for them is more and different work than what is required to replace a condenser and line set,
cues.zh: 现在我知道，安装壁挂机并在墙上钻孔，比更换冷凝器和管线所需的工作更繁重、也更复杂，

cues.en: but I can't see it being $6,000
cues.zh: 但我看不出这能值

cues.en: worth of work. Especially when I did it myself that one time in a day, learning as I went.
cues.zh: 6,000 美元的工钱。特别是考虑到我当年边学边干，自己一个人一天就把它搞定了。

cues.en: Actually, when you consider that the technician who ended up replacing the air conditioner needed torches for brazing,
cues.zh: 事实上，如果你考虑到最终来换空调的技师需要用焊枪进行硬钎焊，

cues.en: had to run copper lines through utility spaces rather than the exterior of the building as they would have for the ductless install,
cues.zh: 不得不把铜管穿过设备层，而不是像无风管安装那样沿着建筑物外墙铺设，

cues.en: and needed to fit a new evaporator coil into a cramped space above the furnace which ended up taking pretty much an entire workday to complete,
cues.zh: 而且还需要把一个新的蒸发器盘管塞进暖气炉上方狭窄的空间里，这基本上花掉了一整个工作日才完成，

cues.en: I can honestly say that I feel like installing the three head system would have been easier for an experienced technician.
cues.zh: 我可以诚实地说，我觉得对一个有经验的技师来说，安装三联机系统反而会更容易。

cues.en: And, by the way, there was already sufficient electrical power at the location for the outside unit.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，现场原本就已经有足够室外机使用的电力了。

cues.en: I will admit, I'm not in the HVAC business,
cues.zh: 我得承认，我不是干暖通这行的，

cues.en: but my gut tells me the company could have made more money on that job in the end if they quoted it at $9,000
cues.zh: 但凭直觉，如果他们当时报价 9000 美元的话，最后这单肯定能赚更多钱，

cues.en: a much easier to swallow price that made the payback period reasonable
cues.zh: 这个价格更容易让人接受，投资回收期也很合理，

cues.en: but trying to get another $3 out of it lost them the sale.
cues.zh: 但非要多榨出 3 块钱，结果把单子搞砸了。

cues.en: If I were to guess, that company puts a fixed percentage markup on all the equipment they sell
cues.zh: 我猜的话，这家公司对他们卖的所有设备都加了固定的利润率，

cues.en: which I would not call savvy,
cues.zh: 这我可不觉得有多高明，

cues.en: but that's just me.
cues.zh: 当然这只是我个人的看法。

cues.en: Now if you think that's bad, here's a real head scratcher.
cues.zh: 如果你觉得这已经够离谱了，那来看看这个更让人摸不着头脑的。

cues.en: My brother lives in San Diego.
cues.zh: 我兄弟住在圣迭戈。

cues.en: If you don't know, San Diego
cues.zh: 如果你不知道的话，圣迭戈

cues.en: really doesn't get cold.
cues.zh: 其实根本不冷。

cues.en: And for some silly reason his home has a central AC with a gas furnace, pretty much the same system you'd find here in Illinois.
cues.zh: 但不知出于什么好笑的原因，他家装的是带燃气暖炉的中央空调，基本上跟你在伊利诺伊州见到的一模一样。

cues.en: Electricity is very expensive there, yes, but there's just hardly a need for heating. He tells me he and his partner used the furnace for just four days this winter.
cues.zh: 那里的电费确实很贵，没错，但根本没多大必要供暖。他告诉我，他和伴侣这个冬天总共就用了四天暖炉。

cues.en: He wanted to get quotes to replace his aging AC with a heat pump,
cues.zh: 他想找人来报价，把快老化的空调换成热泵，

cues.en: and the first company that came out?
cues.zh: 结果第一家上门的公司怎么说？

cues.en: First, they said he'd probably want an expensive hybrid fuel system so he could keep using gas for backup which
cues.zh: 首先，他们说他可能需要一套昂贵的混合燃料系统，这样就能继续用燃气当备用，这

cues.en: no.
cues.zh: 简直胡扯。

cues.en: No. And second, the quote they gave him for a Lennox heat pump and air handler? It came in at over $16,000.
cues.zh: 不可能。其次，他们给 Lennox 热泵和空气处理机的报价是多少？超过了 16,000 美元。

cues.en: And that was the cheap option from this company.
cues.zh: 而且这还是这家公司最便宜的方案。

cues.en: I know that's California,
cues.zh: 我知道那是加利福尼亚，

cues.en: maybe there are some weird permitting costs, but come on. My brother would be perfectly served with a reversible two ton system, maybe three at most.
cues.zh: 也许有些奇奇怪怪的审批成本，但也太离谱了。我兄弟装个两吨的可逆式系统就完全够用了，最多也就三吨。

cues.en: He does not need a hybrid system and he certainly doesn't need a true cold climate heat pump.
cues.zh: 他不需要混合系统，也绝对不需要真正的寒冷气候热泵。

cues.en: And thanks to the internet we know that the equipment cost for a 16 SEER two and a half ton system
cues.zh: 多亏了互联网，我们知道一套 16 SEER、2.5 吨系统的设备成本

cues.en: is probably less than $3,000
cues.zh: 可能连 3000 美元都不到。

cues.en: I mean these people are making their money, too, plus the line set and whatever other miscellaneous stuff.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，这些人也要赚钱，再加上冷媒管和其它七七八八的杂项。

cues.en: I cannot see the quote he got as anything but a dishonest company taking advantage of someone looking to install a trendy heat pump
cues.zh: 我觉得他收到的报价纯粹就是无良公司在坑那些想装个时髦热泵的人，

cues.en: and just hoping they don't know what that is.
cues.zh: 指望别人对这行一无所知。

cues.en: This is probably happening all across the country and indeed the world, and it sucks.
cues.zh: 这种事可能在全国乃至全世界都在发生，太恶心了。

cues.en: Heat pumps are not miracle machines. They're not even new tech.
cues.zh: 热泵不是什么奇迹机器，甚至都不是新技术。

cues.en: And installing one is either much the same process as the air conditioners we've been installing for many decades or potentially easier as is the case for mini splits.
cues.zh: 安装热泵的过程，要么和我们装了几十年的空调大同小异，要么可能更简单，比如分体式空调。

cues.en: I mean, I would not go out and buy a torch, some gas bottles, and learn how to braze copper piping on my own, but I was pretty confident I could tackle a few preformed flare fittings, and I did. Hi. It's me again. I gotta cover a few more things in voice over before the end. First, to make the last few minutes more explicit,
cues.zh: 我是说，我不会特意去买喷灯、气瓶，然后自己学着去焊铜管，但我挺有信心搞定几个预制的扩口接头，而且我也做到了。嗨，又是我。在结束前，我得在配音里补充几点。首先，为了把前面几分钟讲得更透彻一点，

cues.en: the obfuscation
cues.zh: 安装商对设备定价的

cues.en: of equipment pricing by installers is a serious problem and one that, well, I couldn't tell you how to solve.
cues.zh: 刻意隐瞒是个严重的问题，而且老实说，我也不知道该怎么解决。

cues.en: Businesses are gonna business. But a real danger here that's worth a hard look into is that many of the incentives we currently use to push people towards better equipment such as rebates for installing it are ripe for abuse by these installers.
cues.zh: 商人的本性就是赚钱。但这里真正值得深入探讨的一个危险是，我们目前用来推动人们使用更好设备的许多激励措施（例如安装补贴），极易被这些安装商滥用。

cues.en: Whatever savings the rebate might bring can simply evaporate if the installer builds it into the quote.
cues.zh: 返利可能带来的任何省下的钱，如果安装商直接把它加到报价里，就会直接蒸发掉。

cues.en: And when they're inventing their own markups on equipment cost, anything goes.
cues.zh: 当他们自己虚构设备成本的加价时，那就完全无所顾忌了。

cues.en: It would be great if everyone could simply purchase their own equipment directly
cues.zh: 如果每个人都能直接自己购买设备，

cues.en: and then hire installers for the labor only.
cues.zh: 然后只雇佣安装商来做工，那就太棒了。

cues.en: But a lot of rebate programs make this impossible and of course few people have the expertise to determine the equipment they need.
cues.zh: 但很多返利项目让这变得不可能，而且当然很少有人具备确定自己所需设备的专业知识。

cues.en: The best thing I can do is remind everybody that heat pumps are just air conditioners and are not actually special.
cues.zh: 我能做的最好的事情就是提醒大家，热泵其实就是空调，并没有什么特别的。

cues.en: Hopefully the more people that know this the less gouging will occur.
cues.zh: 希望了解这一点的人越多，趁火打劫的情况就会越少。

cues.en: Alright and the other thing I need to talk about is the wrinkle that is subpar ductwork.
cues.zh: 好的，我要谈的另一件事就是风管不合格这个棘手的问题。

cues.en: Thanks to the operational limits of heat pumps, airflow may become a challenge in existing homes thanks to ductwork restrictions.
cues.zh: 由于热泵的运行限制，在现有房屋中，由于风管的限制，气流可能会成为一个挑战。

cues.en: As amazing as refrigeration is, the refrigerant can only get so hot. It's a function of the system pressure, and that means you need a greater volume of air moving over the heat exchanger to get all that heat out.
cues.zh: 不管制冷技术多么神奇，制冷剂的温度也是有限度的。这是系统压力的一个函数，这意味着你需要有更大体积的空气流过热交换器，才能把所有的热量带出来。

cues.en: Ductless systems don't pose a challenge here because the heads are designed to attain a certain heat output and the heat exchanger is huge compared to the air it needs to move.
cues.zh: 无风管系统在这里不会构成挑战，因为室内机旨在达到特定的热输出，而且与它需要移动的空气量相比，热交换器是巨大的。

cues.en: But when you're dealing with a relatively small coil shoved into some ductwork,
cues.zh: 但当你处理的是塞进某些风管里的相对较小的盘管时，

cues.en: you need as much airflow as you can get. And regrettably often, the ductwork wasn't designed with that in mind. A furnace which heats with fire
cues.zh: 你需要尽可能多的气流。而遗憾的是，很多时候，风管的设计并没有考虑到这一点。用明火加热的炉子

cues.en: can make the air leaving it extremely hot, so the ducts didn't need to be designed for the same volume of air as is ideal with a heat pump. It's the same problem with undersized radiators in countries that don't use ducting.
cues.zh: 能让流出的空气变得极其炎热，因此风管的设计不需要像使用热泵那样，达到理想的大风量。那些不使用风管的国家中尺寸偏小的散热器也面临同样的问题。

cues.en: But to be clear, this is a situational problem.
cues.zh: 但需要明确的是，这是一个具体情况具体分析的问题。

cues.en: Your ductwork could be just fine for a heat pump without any reconfiguration.
cues.zh: 你的风管可能完全不需要重新改造，就能直接适配热泵。

cues.en: One possibility is to simply force more air through them with a stronger blower, but that has limitations and can get noisy.
cues.zh: 一种可能性是换用功率更大的送风机，强行把更多空气压进管道，但这有局限性而且噪音会很大。

cues.en: But even if it is a problem in your case,
cues.zh: 但即便对你来说这确实是个问题，

cues.en: the good news is that a situational problem can be dealt with situationally.
cues.zh: 好消息是，针对具体情况可以采取灵活的应对方案。

cues.en: It might be that to match the output of your current heating system, you'd need to have a much larger heat pump than your existing air conditioner.
cues.zh: 为了达到你目前供暖系统的输出功率，你可能需要一个比现有空调大得多的热泵。

cues.en: I saw someone on Twitter bring up that they were told they'd need a five ton heat pump which is 60,000 BTU's per hour or 17.5
cues.zh: 我看到推特上有人提到，别人告诉他们需要一台 5 吨的热泵，顺便说一下，这相当于每小时 60,000 BTU 或 17.5

cues.en: kilowatts by the way. But their ducts were sized only for a three ton air conditioner.
cues.zh: 千瓦。但他们的风管尺寸只够配 3 吨的空调。

cues.en: So they were told the only path to a heat pump was expensive ducting upgrades.
cues.zh: 所以他们被告知，要装热泵就只能花大钱改造风管。

cues.en: But I say, don't let but sometimes
cues.zh: 但我想说，别让这种“但是”的

cues.en: thinking stop you.
cues.zh: 思维阻碍了你。

cues.en: The fact is you rarely need the full output of a heating system anyway.
cues.zh: 事实是，无论如何你很少需要供暖系统全功率运转。

cues.en: Around here they all seem to be oversized by a factor of about two.
cues.zh: 在我们这儿，它们似乎都放大了一倍左右。

cues.en: So it could be that even if you'll only be able to have a three ton heat pump,
cues.zh: 所以，即便你最终只能安装一台 3 吨的热泵，

cues.en: that's gonna be all you need for the majority of the winter anyway.
cues.zh: 无论如何，这也足够应对大半个冬天了。

cues.en: I can tell you that this is exactly the boat that I'm in. My 70,000 BTU furnace only runs about half the time even when it's well below zero outside.
cues.zh: 我可以说，我完全就是这种情况。我的 70,000 BTU 暖风机，即使在室外零度以下，也只开一半左右的时间。

cues.en: So a three ton heat pump, which is 36,000
cues.zh: 所以一台 3 吨的热泵，也就是 36,000

cues.en: BTU,
cues.zh: BTU，

cues.en: would actually be more than enough almost all the time. And by the way, this problem might very well be temporary.
cues.zh: 在几乎所有时候其实都绰绰有余。顺便说一句，这个问题很可能只是暂时的。

cues.en: With new refrigerants and technologies on the horizon, who knows what's possible?
cues.zh: 随着新型制冷剂和技术的出现，谁知道还有什么可能性呢？

cues.en: From what I can tell, there's regrettably a lot of old school thinking permeating the trade. Some of it is understandable.
cues.zh: 据我所知，遗憾的是，这个行业里充斥着很多老派思维。有些是可以理解的。

cues.en: It's hard to explain to customers all the nuances involved here, and they just want an HVAC system that works.
cues.zh: 很难向客户解释其中的种种细微之处，他们只想要一套能正常工作的暖通空调系统。

cues.en: But some of it is also just weird.
cues.zh: 但有些也确实很奇怪。

cues.en: My friend's quote for a three head mini split seems absolutely bonkers to me, but it's become clear from conversations I've had that lots of HVAC companies are charging similar amounts.
cues.zh: 我朋友那台三头迷你分体机的报价在我看来简直离谱，但从我交流过的情况来看，很多暖通空调公司都在收差不多的价格。

cues.en: They're seemingly allergic to mini splits for some reason, which is a real shame since they're a great option when you have limitations like poor ductwork.
cues.zh: 他们似乎出于某种原因对迷你分体机过敏，这真是可惜，因为当你面临风管不佳等限制时，它们是个很好的选择。

cues.en: We are entering a strange new phase of indoor comfort.
cues.zh: 我们正在进入室内舒适性的一个奇怪新阶段。

cues.en: Much of it is the same but refined,
cues.zh: 大部分还是老样子，但更精细了，

cues.en: and yet there are also entirely new opportunities to be found.
cues.zh: 然而也存在着全新的机会。

cues.en: We just need equipment to get a little bit better, easier to obtain,
cues.zh: 我们只需要设备再好一点、更容易获得，

cues.en: and for companies to sell it to you and do the work for a fair price.
cues.zh: 以及公司能以公道的价格卖给你并完成安装。

cues.en: Okay. I'm starting to run out of hot air.
cues.zh: 好了，我快没话可说了。

cues.en: So I wanna talk about a couple more things before the jazz hits.
cues.zh: 所以在爵士乐响起之前，我还想再聊几件事。

cues.en: First,
cues.zh: 首先，

cues.en: ambient noise.
cues.zh: 环境噪音。

cues.en: Hate pumps, unfortunately,
cues.zh: 不幸的是，热泵

cues.en: make noise and this has some people worried.
cues.zh: 会发出噪音，这让一些人感到担忧。

cues.en: Now, for the record, and I know this doesn't make it right or anything, we are surrounded by pretty loud heat pumps in the summer and we're
cues.zh: 声明一下，我知道这并不能说明它没问题，夏天我们周围都是相当吵的热泵，而我们

cues.en: mostly alright. However, modern heat pumps are so much quieter than the air conditioners we're used to now. Some of that is simply because they don't do that whole thing
cues.zh: 基本上也还好。不过，现代热泵比我们现在习惯的空调安静多了。部分原因很简单，就是它们不会做那种

cues.en: old fashioned AC units do when they start up.
cues.zh: 老式空调启动时做的整套动作。

cues.en: That's when you notice an air conditioner the most. Once it's running, you tend to just filter it out.
cues.zh: 你最容易被空调注意到的时候，就是它运行起来的那一刻。一旦它开始运转，你往往会自动忽略它。

cues.en: Inverter driven compressors have a slow ramp up in speed and you basically don't even notice it. Plus, aside from the whole hard start thing, they're just much quieter in general. Mostly because unless it's so cold or so hot that it needs to give it all it's got,
cues.zh: 变频驱动的压缩机转速提升很慢，你基本上根本不会注意到。而且，除了启动那一下比较猛之外，它们整体上也安静得多。主要是因为除非天气太冷或太热，需要它全力运转，

cues.en: it's running at a slow barely audible speed.
cues.zh: 否则它都是以几乎听不见的低速运行。

cues.en: Like this. This is me talking to you in my normal speaking voice right next to a heat pump.
cues.zh: 就像这样。这是我在热泵旁边用正常说话的音量跟你讲话。

cues.en: And this one is actually working pretty hard right now. Let's wait till it gets to temperature and see how much quieter it gets.
cues.zh: 而这台现在其实正在比较费力地工作。我们等它达到设定温度，看看能安静多少。

cues.en: Okay. So now the indoor temperature is at the set point, and the heat pump has slowed down to basically an idle speed.
cues.zh: 好。现在室内温度已经达到设定值，热泵已经降速到基本怠速的状态。

cues.en: The great thing about the inverter compressor technology that you find even in pretty cheap heat pumps like this is that they will operate at whatever capacity they need to for the given load.
cues.zh: 变频压缩机技术的好处在于——即使是你在这类相当便宜的热泵上也能找到的——它们会根据当前负荷以所需的任何能力运行。

cues.en: Rather than run for ten minutes and stay off for thirty, this can actually run at 25%
cues.zh: 而不是运行十分钟、停三十分钟，它实际上可以以25%

cues.en: output.
cues.zh: 的输出运行。

cues.en: That means it's less disruptive because you don't hear starting and stopping, but it also just means it's quieter from the start.
cues.zh: 这意味着它的干扰更小，因为你听不到启动和停止的声音，但也意味着它从一开始就更安静。

cues.en: This is the ambient noise level that this heat pump operates at for the vast majority of the time. The only thing you notice in the winter is when it defrosts, you hear it stop, start, stop, and start again.
cues.zh: 这是这台热泵绝大部分时间运行时的环境噪音水平。冬天你唯一会注意到的是它除霜的时候，你会听到它停下、启动、停下、又启动。

cues.en: So while I...
cues.zh: 所以虽然我……

cues.en: Oh, it just stopped.
cues.zh: 哦，它停了。

cues.en: So while I understand that people are concerned about the outdoor
cues.zh: 所以我理解人们担心室外

cues.en: ambient environment and the additional noise,
cues.zh: 环境以及额外的噪音，

cues.en: it's honestly not as bad as you might think.
cues.zh: 但说实话，没你想的那么糟。

cues.en: I saw a tweet about someone looking to install a heat pump in Seattle but they were told it would be illegal thanks to strict noise ordinances.
cues.zh: 我看到一条推文，说有人想在Seattle装热泵，但被告知由于严格的噪音条例，这是违法的。

cues.en: Guys, you gotta update those. I mean, for one, I kinda doubt a good mini split would actually violate that ordinance but if it does,
cues.zh: 各位，得更新那些条例了。首先，我有点怀疑一台好的mini split真会违反那条例，但如果真违反了，

cues.en: well looks like there's an ordinance we gotta toss out.
cues.zh: 那看来这条例就该废掉。

cues.en: Not only are they just not that loud anymore but if slightly louder outdoor environments are the price we have to pay to help reduce carbon emissions and increase energy independence,
cues.zh: 它们不仅不再那么吵了，而且如果稍微吵一点的室外环境是我们为帮助减少碳排放和增强能源独立所付出的代价，

cues.en: I think it's worth it, don't you?
cues.zh: 我觉得值得，你不觉得吗？

cues.en: If nimbys get in the way of installing heat pumps, may god have mercy on our souls.
cues.zh: 如果NIMBY们阻挠安装热泵，愿上帝宽恕我们。

cues.en: Lastly, let's talk about packaged heat pumps. They exist, but right now they seem to have some performance challenges which,
cues.zh: 最后，聊聊整体式热泵。它们确实存在，但目前似乎有些性能挑战，

cues.en: well, I'm not surprised by.
cues.zh: 嗯，我不意外。

cues.en: One very common packaged heating and cooling thingy is the PTAC which stands for Packaged Terminal Air Conditioner.
cues.zh: 一种非常常见的整体式供暖和制冷设备是PTAC，即Packaged Terminal Air Conditioner（整体式终端空调）。

cues.en: If you've ever stayed in a low to medium tier hotel in The US, you're probably familiar with the beige lump of cooling sitting below the window.
cues.zh: 如果你住过美国的中低档酒店，可能熟悉窗下那个米色的制冷疙瘩。

cues.en: That's a PTAC.
cues.zh: 那就是PTAC。

cues.en: They're also kinda common in certain residential settings, too.
cues.zh: 它们在 certain 住宅环境中也挺常见。

cues.en: Luckily, the PTAC has been developed into the PFP or packaged terminal heat pump.
cues.zh: 幸运的是，PTAC 已经发展成了 PFP，也就是整体式终端热泵。

cues.en: Right now, NEEP barely has any data on these and what they do have isn't great.
cues.zh: 目前，NEEP 几乎没有关于这些设备的数据，而他们现有的数据也不乐观。

cues.en: The PTAC is a design optimized more for ease of installation by way of standardization
cues.zh: PTAC 这种设计，更多是通过标准化来优化安装便利性

cues.en: than objective performance.
cues.zh: 而不是客观性能。

cues.en: Hotels love them because they can be swapped out in minutes and just by keeping a few spares on hand, out of order rooms due to heating and cooling issues can be largely avoided.
cues.zh: 酒店喜欢它们，因为几分钟就能换一台，而且只要手头备几台备用机，因冷暖问题导致的房间停用基本就能避免。

cues.en: Until recently,
cues.zh: 直到最近，

cues.en: these provided heat via resistive heating elements, but lately the refrigeration circuits are becoming reversible.
cues.zh: 这些设备靠电阻加热元件供热，但最近制冷回路开始变得可逆。

cues.en: I suspect these are going to have some upper performance boundaries because,
cues.zh: 我怀疑这类产品会遇到性能上限，因为，

cues.en: well, their design is quite a compromise.
cues.zh: 嗯，它们的设计妥协太多了。

cues.en: If you actually were to remove the PTAC from its sleeve you'd discover that the PTAC is the only thing separating the inside from the outside.
cues.zh: 如果你真把 PTAC 从套筒里抽出来，你会发现 PTAC 是室内与室外之间唯一的隔挡。

cues.en: That vent you see from the outside of a building that utilizes PTACs is
cues.zh: 你从使用 PTAC 的建筑外侧看到的那个通风口，

cues.en: literally a large hole in the wall.
cues.zh: 其实就是墙上一个大洞。

cues.en: PTACs are really more like the guts of a window unit made to slide into a standard sleeve
cues.zh: PTAC 其实更像是窗机的内部构件，被做成能滑入标准套筒的样子

cues.en: with strip heaters, too.
cues.zh: 而且还带条式加热器。

cues.en: It's likely the case that buildings which currently use PTACs would be better off to DPAC.
cues.zh: 目前使用 PTAC 的建筑，很可能改用 DPAC 会更好。

cues.en: Hotels might consider replacing banks of 10 or 15 rooms with a large roof mounted VRF system,
cues.zh: 酒店可以考虑用屋顶安装的大型 VRF 系统，替换每 10 或 15 间客房一组的 PTAC，

cues.en: and apartments might want to convert to ductless mini splits.
cues.zh: 公寓则可能想改成无管道迷你分体式空调。

cues.en: Actually, my old apartment building would be much better served by ductless heat pumps.
cues.zh: 事实上，我的老旧公寓楼如果用无风管热泵效果会好得多。

cues.en: With the bathrooms on interior walls, I would only have needed a three head system for my two bedroom apartment, two small heads for the bedrooms, and a large one for the living room, kitchen, and dining area.
cues.zh: 由于卫生间都在内墙上，我那套两居室只需要一个三头系统就行了：两个小内机给卧室，一个大内机给客厅、厨房和餐厅区。

cues.en: Speaking of my old apartment,
cues.zh: 说到我的老房子，

cues.en: another less common packaged system is the well
cues.zh: 另一种不太常见的组合式系统是……呃，

cues.en: actually I don't know what its non trade name is but the Magic Pack.
cues.zh: 其实我不知道它的通用名称是什么，也就是 Magic Pack。

cues.en: This thing is a packaged furnace and AC system.
cues.zh: 这东西是一个集成式的暖气和空调系统。

cues.en: It's kind of a clever idea but anyone who has to replace one of these, you have my sympathies.
cues.zh: 这算是个挺聪明的点子，但谁要是得换这玩意儿，我可太同情你了。

cues.en: They're not made by many manufacturers and you're pretty much stuck with a single option.
cues.zh: 没多少厂家生产这东西，你基本上只能硬着头皮选唯一的一种。

cues.en: But apartment buildings in my area are still getting built to use them. It's obvious from the outside because they have a very particular vent arrangement.
cues.zh: 但我这片区域的公寓楼现在还在装这玩意儿。从外面一眼就能看出来，因为它们有非常特殊的排气口布局。

cues.en: I imagine these will have the same airflow issues as PTHPs
cues.zh: 我猜这些东西也会有和 PTHP 一样的气流问题，

cues.en: so, again,
cues.zh: 所以说，

cues.en: buildings which use these might be best served by mini splits.
cues.zh: 用这些玩意的建筑换成迷你分体式空调可能会更好。

cues.en: And then of course there's the venerable window unit.
cues.zh: 然后当然还有老牌的窗机。

cues.en: These
cues.zh: 这些东西

cues.en: actually could probably be turned into pretty decent heat pumps.
cues.zh: 其实完全可以改成相当不错的热泵。

cues.en: The bigger issue there is that window units, as a rule,
cues.zh: 更大的问题在于，通常情况下窗机

cues.en: aren't making a good seal between inside and outside.
cues.zh: 很难在室内和室外之间做到良好的密封。

cues.en: So while a window unit esque cold climate heat pump can certainly be built,
cues.zh: 所以，虽然像窗机那样的寒冷地区热泵确实造得出来，

cues.en: it would probably be better if it were put through a wall and sealed up with expanding foam.
cues.zh: 但如果能把它嵌入墙内并用发泡胶密封好，效果可能会更好。

cues.en: And I suppose at that point you're just reinventing the p tach but with perhaps better outside airflow.
cues.zh: 我想在那时候，你其实只是在重新发明分体式空调，只不过可能外部气流更好了点。

cues.en: This is why mini splits are pretty cool. Oh and yes, I've seen that neat looking low profile heat pump thingy.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么无风管迷你分体机这么酷。哦对了，我也见过那个看起来很精巧的超薄热泵玩意儿。

cues.en: I'll be interested in its performance numbers because assuming they're good and you can seal it and the window up well enough,
cues.zh: 我对它的性能数据很感兴趣，因为假设性能不错，而且你能把缝隙和窗户密封得足够好，

cues.en: that could be a very powerful idea for certain places.
cues.zh: 对于某些地方来说，这会是一个非常厉害的点子。
